name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Orders & kitchen, food truck
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect your kitchen from too many orders and keep serving when the network drops. The ordering app for food truck teams.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your team sees all orders on a single screen, confirms what the kitchen can prepare, then marks them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T KEEP
State how much your kitchen can prepare at once, and in how much time. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it: the queue follows the kitchen’s pace.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE COUNTER
Add counter (walk-up) orders on the same screen as orders placed in advance: the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SINGLE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what comes next and what is ready, with an alert when an order needs to be started.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a ticket printer in the kitchen over Bluetooth or via your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE NETWORK DROPS
Switch on offline protection: if the connection is cut, ordering in advance pauses so nobody places an order you wouldn’t see. Orders you take on the device are kept and sync as soon as you are back online.

DESIGNED FOR THE TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, be notified when an order needs confirming and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and your locations once, and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their teams. A HatchGrab account is required to sign in.
